notes.title: v1.3.3. Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the bomb gimmick appeared at an unintended scale for online guests only.

notes.title: v1.3.1 Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when certain buttons were pressed on the menu screen or during battles.

notes.title: v1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
New rule "Treasure Battle" has been implemented!

【Rules】
[olist]
  Collect as many coins as possible within 1 minute in 1 stage
  Revive immediately when defeated! Keep your ninja tools!
  Fight for [x] rounds, the person with the most coins wins!
[/olist]

Enjoy even more intense battles than regular battles! Please give it a try!

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Updated to Version 1.2.0

- Implemented Free Match
Created a lobby system for matchmaking without passwords
- Modified some UI designs
- Implemented Staff Roll
- Preparation for adding new rules

notes.title: v1.0.1 Update (Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
We have updated the game to version v1.0.1, which includes the following bug fixes:

[Online]
- Upon starting a battle, only the guest’s character weapon/crown would appear.
- Fixed an issue where another player could enter the Lobby after a battle.
- Fixed an issue where the pause screen would sometimes fail to appear when pressing the pause button.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

If you encounter any other bugs, or have any requests or feedback, please feel free to contact us.


Thank you for your continued support of Ninjam!
